translations.web: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
translations.bsb: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.
translations.kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
translations.asv: For they refreshed my spirit and yours: acknowledge ye therefore them that are such.
